header.title: How to Repair a Washing Machine that Doesn't Spin
header.description: This guide provides basic troubleshooting steps for a washing machine that fails to spin, starting with simple checks and escalating to professional assistance.

steps.description: Check the clothes load in the washing machine and reposition it if it's unbalanced.
This step instructs the user to examine the lid tab and lid switch for damage or malfunction.
actions: Examine the tab on the lid.
Press and release the lid switch.
Check if the switch clicks when pressed and released.
Replace the switch (if tested and necessary).

steps.description: This step involves inspecting the washing machine belt for looseness, wear, or breakage, and potentially tightening or replacing it.
actions: Replace the belt (requires disassembly and assembly)

steps.description: If previous steps don't resolve the issue, contact a professional repairman due to the complexity of the washing machine's electronic controls.
actions: Assess if all previous steps are in order.
Recognize the problem may be in the electronic controls.
Do not attempt to repair the electronics.
